title: Viva Wallet
meta_description: Change the way you are getting paid
full_description: The Viva Wallet app is the free money management app for using your Viva Wallet cards, IBANs and more.WHAT'S NEW:Accept payments fast and easy with Payment notifications! Send an email, share the link or the QR code and get paid in seconds!We also implemented our regular improvements for a more stable and smooth user experience across the app.Get started:• Open your merchant account easily from your phone with no waiting time or delays.Sales history and reports:• Monitor your business performance at a glance• Issue refunds to your customers• View real-time Sales history• View details for Sales transactionsManage your expenses and money:• Create and manage IBANs• Send and receive money• Create and manage Digital and Physical cards for you or your employees• Move money between your IBANs and your employee cards• Match receipts with transactions to make expense reporting effortlessOther features:• Instant push notifications for account activity and transactions• Switch between personal and business accounts• Verify your account•  Support Scan RF for bill payments• Bill payments via mobileSupported languages:• English• Bulgarian• Croatian• Danish• Finnish• French• German• Dutch• Greek• Hungarian• Polish• Romanian• Portuguese• Spanish• Italian• Swedish• CzechQuestions? We're here to help: vivawallet.com
